set.body: Add RRR as a directed paired latent method rather than a standalone regression subsystem. Acceptance: ReducedRankRegression.fit returns a PairedLatentFit plus fullCoefficient, workingCoefficient, and response-scale prediction API; OLS uses linalg least-squares capabilities; rank validation and row mismatch failures are typed.
set.title: Multivar: add reduced-rank regression fit
